title: Acute Lower Back Pain with Radiation
candidateBrief: You are a doctor in a GP surgery. David Thompson, 65, has come in about Low back pain. Take a focused history. You have 8 minutes.

patient.name: David Thompson
patient.persona: Retired school teacher living alone, speaks calmly and provides clear answers without volunteering extra information.
patient.openingLine: I’ve got low back pain that started yesterday when I was unloading groceries.

rubric.label: Introduces self and gains consent
rubric.exampleQuestion: Hello, I'm one of the doctors. Is it okay if I ask you some questions today?

rubric.label: Opens with an open question and lets the patient speak
offlineCues: what can i do for you

rubric.label: Asks when it started and how it has changed
rubric.exampleQuestion: When did this start, and has it changed since?

rubric.label: Asks what it is like and how bad it is
rubric.exampleQuestion: What does it feel like, and how bad is it out of ten?

rubric.label: Asks about associated symptoms
rubric.exampleQuestion: Have you noticed anything else along with it?

rubric.label: Takes a past medical history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Do you have any medical conditions, or have you had any operations?

rubric.label: Asks about medicines and allergies
rubric.exampleQuestion: Are you taking any medicines, and do you have any allergies?

rubric.label: Asks about family history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Does anything like this run in your family?

rubric.label: Takes a smoking and alcohol history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Do you smoke, and how much alcohol do you drink in a week?

rubric.label: Asks about work, home and daily life
rubric.exampleQuestion: What do you do for work, and who is at home with you?

rubric.label: Screens the other systems
rubric.exampleQuestion: Any weight loss, fevers or night sweats?

rubric.label: Explores the patient's ideas, concerns and expectations
rubric.exampleQuestion: Is there anything in particular you are worried this might be?

rubric.label: Summarises, checks understanding and invites questions
rubric.exampleQuestion: Can I summarise what you have told me? Do you have any questions?

rubric.label: Says what to do if it gets worse
rubric.exampleQuestion: If it gets worse, or you feel much more unwell, call 111 or come straight back.

facts.text: The pain started yesterday while I was unloading groceries from my pickup truck.

source.quote: It started yesterday, I was unloading groceries from my pickup truck when it suddenly started.

facts.text: The pain is in my lower back and feels stabbing.

source.quote: It feels like it's stabbing just right in my lower back.

facts.text: When I sit completely still, the pain is 2 out of 10.

source.quote: If I'm sitting, uh completely still like like I am right now, it's a 2 out of 10.

facts.text: The pain gets worse when I move, bend my back, or even cough.

source.quote: Uh anytime I I move or bend my back or uh even cough it it worsens the pain significantly.

facts.text: The pain has not changed since it started yesterday.

source.quote: No, it's been this same awful pain this whole time.

facts.text: I also feel the pain going into my right leg as an aching sensation.

source.quote: I also feel the pain uh into my right leg.

facts.text: I have had back pain over the years, but nothing like this before.

source.quote: I've had back pain uh over the years, but nothing like this before.

I take insulin for my diabetes.
